description: A wide 16:9 sequence diagram of one function-calling round trip, read left to right, with three tall vertical lanes as rounded columns. Left lane header: 'Our code (Ask Rasoi)'. Middle lane header: 'LLM (gemini-3.8-flash)'. Right lane header: 'Bahi ERP'. Six numbered horizontal arrows going down the page in order: arrow 1 from 'Our code' to 'LLM' labelled '1  messages + tool definitions (JSON)'. Arrow 2 from 'LLM' back to 'Our code' labelled '2  tool_call: check_stock {item_code: GSK-SIL-05L}'. Arrow 3 from 'Our code' to 'Bahi ERP' labelled '3  our code runs the tool in Kavita's session'. Arrow 4 from 'Bahi ERP' back to 'Our code' labelled '4  result: 54,000 on hand in Pune'. Arrow 5 from 'Our code' to 'LLM' labelled '5  tool result message'. Arrow 6 from 'LLM' to 'Our code' labelled '6  answer in words'. A thin dashed vertical barrier between the LLM lane and the Bahi lane with the small label 'the model never touches Bahi'. Arrows 1, 2, 5, 6 in sky blue, arrows 3 and 4 in ember orange. The three lane headers are exactly 'Our code (Ask Rasoi)', 'LLM (gemini-3.8-flash)' and 'Bahi ERP', and nothing above them. Do not add any column headers, row headers, section titles or labels other than the ones quoted here. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 figure with two panels side by side, separated by a thin vertical rule. LEFT panel caption at its top: 'Without a standard: N x M'. In it, a column of 3 rounded boxes on the left labelled 'Ask Rasoi', 'Claude Desktop', 'Workflow Studio', and a column of 3 rounded boxes on the right labelled 'Bahi toolbox', 'Email', 'Calendar'. Every left box is joined to every right box by its own thin ember-orange line, 9 lines in total, crossing like a tangle; a small note under the panel: '3 apps x 3 tool sets = 9 integrations'. RIGHT panel caption at its top: 'With MCP: N + M'. The same 3 app boxes on the left and the same 3 tool boxes on the right, but each app has one short sky-blue line into a single tall central vertical bar labelled 'MCP', and each tool box has one short sky-blue line from that bar, 6 lines in total; a small note under the panel: '3 + 3 = 6 connections'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 architecture diagram of the three MCP roles, left to right. On the LEFT a large rounded container labelled 'Host' with the subtitle 'the app the person uses: Ask Rasoi or Claude Desktop'. Inside the host, top: a box 'LLM'. Inside the host, bottom: two smaller boxes stacked, each labelled 'MCP client', one per connected server. In the MIDDLE, two horizontal double-headed arrows leaving the two client boxes, each labelled 'JSON-RPC: tools/list, tools/call'. On the RIGHT two rounded boxes labelled 'MCP server: bahi-toolbox (15 tools)' and 'MCP server: email'. To the far right of the bahi-toolbox server, an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2' joined by a short line labelled 'Kavita's session'. Under the figure three short captions aligned under each role: under Host 'holds the model and the conversation', under the arrows 'one client per server', under the servers 'lists tools and runs them'. Sky blue for host and clients, green outline for servers, ember only for Bahi. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 diagram of one tool folder and where it goes. On the LEFT, a file-tree card titled 'toolbox/create_purchase_request/' with two file rows: 'tool.json' with the note 'what the model reads: name, description, input_schema, writes' and 'tool.py' with the note 'what runs: def run(s, **args)'. From this card, four arrows fan out to the RIGHT to four rounded boxes stacked vertically, each with a short subtitle: 'Ask Rasoi chat' subtitle 'schemas go to the LLM', 'MCP server' subtitle 'tools/list and tools/call', 'Workflow Studio' subtitle 'each tool is a node', 'Tools explorer page' subtitle 'shows the JSON and the Python'. Below the folder card, a small ember-orange box 'Bahi services: pr_search, pr_fetch, usr_get, bud_check, pr_save, pr_submit, pr_get' joined to tool.py by a short line labelled 'calls'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 comparison figure with two horizontal bands. TOP band, light ember-orange tint, caption at its top left: 'Raw services: 41 tools'. Inside it a neat grid of exactly 41 small rounded chips, 11 per row in 4 rows (the last row has 8), each chip showing exactly one of these names, in this order: 'itm_search', 'itm_get', 'sup_search', 'sup_get', 'sup_create', 'sup_cert_get', 'sup_cert_upload', 'sup_rate_get', 'cc_list', 'cc_get', 'whs_list', 'tax_list', 'pt_list', 'usr_get', 'usr_roles', 'stk_query', 'stk_ledger', 'stk_reorder_list', 'pr_fetch', 'pr_save', 'pr_submit', 'pr_approve', 'pr_get', 'pr_search', 'po_fetch', 'po_save', 'po_get', 'po_search', 'po_hist', 'po_pending_appr', 'po_approve', 'po_reject', 'po_release', 'po_amend', 'po_cancel', 'tax_compute', 'bud_check', 'ntf_send', 'grn_save', 'grn_get', 'grn_search'. Every chip uses one of those 41 names exactly; do not invent or shorten any name. A note at the top right of the band: 'the model must know the order'. BOTTOM band, light sky-blue tint, caption at its top left: 'Toolbox: 15 tools, one per business activity'. Inside it 15 rounded chips in 3 rows of 5, slightly larger, horizontal text, names in this order: 'find_item', 'check_stock', 'find_supplier', 'check_budget', 'search_policy', 'create_purchase_request', 'list_my_approvals', 'approve_purchase_request', 'create_purchase_order', 'approve_purchase_order', 'release_purchase_order', 'order_status', 'receive_goods', 'register_supplier', 'send_message'. A note at the top right of the bottom band: 'the tool knows the order'. No connecting lines between the bands. Do not add any column headers, row headers, section titles or labels other than the ones quoted here. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 figure with two panels side by side. LEFT panel title: 'stdio'. A box 'Claude Desktop' on the left and a box 'python -m bahi.toolbox.mcp --user KJOSHI' on the right, labelled underneath 'child process on the same computer'. Between them two horizontal arrows, the top one labelled 'stdin: one JSON message per line', the bottom one going back labelled 'stdout: one JSON message per line'. RIGHT panel title: 'Streamable HTTP'. A box 'Ask Rasoi (web app)' on the left and a box 'bahi-toolbox server at /mcp' on the right, labelled underneath 'a server on the network'. Between them two arrows, the top one labelled 'POST /mcp: the JSON-RPC message', the bottom one going back labelled 'reply: JSON or a stream of events, with mcp-session-id'. Under both panels a single centred line: 'the same JSON-RPC messages, two different pipes'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A wide 16:9 figure with two horizontal rows comparing whose permissions an MCP server carries. TOP row, sky blue: a box 'Ask Rasoi, Kavita signed in', an arrow to a box 'MCP server started as KJOSHI', an arrow to a box 'Bahi: Kavita's role and her Rs 2,50,000 limit', and at the end a result tag 'approve PO/2026/01179: ACCESS DENIED (ERR-SEC-0001)'. BOTTOM row, ember orange: a box 'Ask Rasoi, anyone', an arrow to a box 'MCP server started as SVC_AGENT', an arrow to a box 'Bahi: service account, no limit', and at the end a result tag 'approve PO/2026/01179: APPROVED by SVC_AGENT'. A short caption between the rows on the left: 'same tool, same call'.  Do not add any column headers, row headers, section titles or labels other than the ones quoted here. Labels as plain text, no brackets.
